Data Table

Data tables layer sorting, selection, pagination, and filtering on top of the base table for exploring large datasets.

Sorting

Make headers clickable to sort. The demo below toggles order per column via .zak-docs-table.custom-sortable; the placeholder markup uses .zak-srt-heading to mark sortable headers.

Name ↕ Revenue ↕ Users ↕ Growth
Acme Corp$1,200.0084↑ 12%
Globex Inc$840.0052↑ 6%
Initech$2,310.00128↓ 3%
Umbrella LLC$430.0031↑ 9%
HTML
<th class="zak-srt-heading" data-sort-type="string">
  <span class="zak-srt-heading-label">Name</span>
  <span class="zak-srt-heading-icon">↕</span>
</th>

Compact Mode

Combine .zak-table-sm with right-aligned numeric columns for dense analytical tables.

Metric Jan Feb Mar
Page views12,00013,60015,900
Sessions7,8008,2009,100
Conversion2.4%2.6%2.9%

HTML
<table class="zak-table zak-table-sm">
  <thead><tr><th>Metric</th><th>Jan</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Page views</td><td>12,000</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

Demo JavaScript

The interactions above (sorting, row selection, search/filter, column visibility) are demo helpers that you can reuse or adapt.

JavaScript
// Sorting: toggle asc/desc on sortable headers
document.querySelectorAll('#sort-table .zak-srt-heading').forEach(function (th) {
  th.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var tbody = document.querySelector('#sort-table tbody');
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tbody.rows);
    var index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(th.parentNode.children, th);
    var type = th.dataset.sortType;
    var dir = th.dataset.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    th.dataset.dir = dir;
    tbody.querySelectorAll('.zak-srt-icon').forEach(function (i) { i.textContent = '↕'; });
    var icon = th.querySelector('.zak-srt-heading-icon');
    icon.textContent = dir === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓';
    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      var av = type === 'number'
        ? Number(a.children[index].dataset.value)
        : a.children[index].textContent.trim();
      var bv = type === 'number'
        ? Number(b.children[index].dataset.value)
        : b.children[index].textContent.trim();
      if (av < bv) return dir === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (av > bv) return dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });
    rows.forEach(function (row) { tbody.appendChild(row); });
  });
});

// Selection: select-all toggles rows and .zak-row-selected
document.querySelectorAll('thead input#select-all').forEach(function (head) {
  head.addEventListener('change', function () {
    var group = head.closest('#select-table').id;
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#' + group + ' .row-check');
    var trs = document.querySelectorAll('#' + group + ' tbody tr');
    rows.forEach(function (cb, i) { cb.checked = head.checked; trs[i].classList.toggle('zak-row-selected', head.checked); });
  });
});
document.querySelectorAll('.row-check').forEach(function (cb) {
  cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
    cb.closest('tr').classList.toggle('zak-row-selected', cb.checked);
  });
});

// Search / filter
var searchInput = document.getElementById('table-search');
var filterSelect = document.getElementById('table-filter');
var filterRows = document.querySelectorAll('#filter-table tbody tr');
function applyFilter() {
  var q = (searchInput.value || '').toLowerCase();
  var cat = filterSelect.value;
  filterRows.forEach(function (row) {
    var text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();
    var match = text.indexOf(q) !== -1 && (cat === 'all' || row.dataset.category === cat);
    row.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
searchInput.addEventListener('input', applyFilter);
filterSelect.addEventListener('change', applyFilter);

// Column visibility: checkboxes show/hide th/td by index
document.querySelectorAll('.column-toggle input').forEach(function (box) {
  box.addEventListener('change', function () {
    var table = document.getElementById('colvis-table');
    var colId = box.dataset.col;
    var index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(
      table.querySelectorAll('thead th'),
      table.querySelector('#' + colId)
    );
    table.querySelectorAll('th, td').forEach(function (cell, i) {
      var col = i % table.querySelectorAll('thead th').length;
      if (col === index) cell.style.display = box.checked ? '' : 'none';
    });
  });
});

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-tableBase table styles (see Table)
.zak-table-smCompact density for dense tables
.zak-table-hoverRow hover highlight
.zak-row-selectedHighlight for selected rows
.zak-srt-headingMarks a sortable header
.zak-inputSearch input above the table
.zak-selectFilter dropdown above the table
.zak-paginationPage controls below the table

Accessibility

  • Link checkboxes to rows with aria-labelledby pointing at the row's primary cell id.
  • Announce sort state to screen readers (e.g. aria-sort="ascending") instead of only changing the arrow glyph.
  • Keep the search input labeled with a visible or aria-label.
  • Ensure row action buttons have descriptive aria-labels.
  • Hiding columns must not hide essential meaning; provide a way to reset visibility.
  • Pagination links should mark the current page with aria-current="page".
